yt_title: Sagittarius Season 2026: Key Astrology Dates to New Year's

slides.label: Nov 13
slides.text: *Mercury and Venus* both go direct. Send the email. *Sign the lease.*

slides.label: Nov 22
slides.text: The Sun enters *Sagittarius* at 2:23 a.m. ET. Travel, learning, *saying yes*.

slides.label: Dec 8
slides.text: *New Moon in Sagittarius* at 7:52 p.m. ET. Name *one big goal* for 2027.

slides.label: Dec 10 to 12
slides.text: *Saturn and Neptune* go direct and *Jupiter* turns retrograde. Progress and second thoughts *arrive together*.

slides.label: Dec 21
slides.text: *Winter solstice*, Capricorn season. Turn the goal into a *plan*. No eclipses until New Year's.

cta_line: Use the clear road *while you have it*.
